title: Generic localization isomorphism for a birational affine map
statement: Let $\varphi:B\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. Let $\mathfrak q$ and $\mathfrak p$ be the unique minimal prime ideals of $B$ and $A$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-irreducible-components-minimal-primes], respectively, and assume $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak p)=\mathfrak q$. If the induced map on local rings $B_{\mathfrak q}\to A_{\mathfrak p}$ is an isomorphism, then the canonical map $B_{\mathfrak q}\to A_{\mathfrak q}$, where $A_{\mathfrak q}$ denotes localization of $A$ at the image of $B\setminus\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], is an isomorphism.
